description: Identical catalog, with an instance handler whose own body raises before returning a response. This is section 8.3's 'callback exceptions' in its literal form: the exception escapes from inside translationFailureHandler.handle at DefaultStrings.java:749-750, before any TranslationFailureResponse action is inspected, so neither the returned-key nor the returned-string arm can run. The oracle's throw-in-handler behavior raises an IllegalStateException carrying the configured message.
